items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That would be Curtis Fuller, Cedar Walton, Ron Carter, Al Harewood, and me.

ctx.x: What are you looking forward to? You’re going to Kennedy Center. What’s your schedule now when you leave here? When are you leaving L.A.? What’s your schedule look like? Rehearsals, performances, tours.

I’m leaving here Monday, the 12th of January. I’ll be in New York, play some things. I’m trying to get my chops together, because I haven’t playing this thing here. I don’t want to have to apologize on the 24th, because I can’t play. So I’ve got to get my chops in shape and write a couple of things. Then we start rehearsing. Oh, wait a minute. The 21st is an outreach program. I go to the Duke Ellington school there, do a thing at the high school. Then on the 23rd we have the rehearsal. At the rehearsal, Max…
